final: SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(cnt) AS avg_record_count FROM (SELECT t.observstation AS observstation, o.weathprofile AS weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile)
